frozen.selection: final fixed consumed-label budget, no test tuning
frozen.final_batch: keep row-major labels until the exact remaining budget, set all other labels to -100; log discarded labels
frozen.not_matched: optimizer updates, input/padding positions, FLOPs, length distribution and unique groups

limits: equal supervised-label budget does not imply equal compute or number of updates
6..8 is in-support for extended training and out-of-support for short training; 9..10 remains external to both
all final seed results retained; no post-test tuning
